title: Appeal 14929: unprotected walls and openings on an existing dwelling after a property line adjustment, with a no-build easement and approved 6-plex
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record
code_edition: 2014 ORSC 302.1 (info sheet). Covenant image page cites 2011 ORSC 302.1, so the record is internally inconsistent

facts.text: Appeal item: R302.1 exterior walls; the existing dwelling would be about 0.26 to 0.41 feet from the new line after a property line adjustment, with no eaves on the east facade.

Proposed alternate: a 5.74-foot no-build easement on the adjoining lot to give 6 feet between building walls and at least 4 feet between eaves; the neighbouring 6-plex is to be sprinklered with fire-rated walls.
Decision block grants the appeal provided the 6-plex projections comply with OSSC Section 705.2 and the no-build covenant is amended to reflect the changes.
